sehemu: Part VII: Special Constitutional Court of the United Republic
jina: Jurisdiction of the Special Constitutional Court
maudhui: (1) The sole function of the Special Constitutional Court of the United Republic shall be to hear a matter brought before it and give a conciliatory decision on any question concerning the interpretation of this Constitution where that interpretation or its application is disputed between the Government of the United Republic and the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar. (2) In performing its function under this Article, the Special Constitutional Court shall have no jurisdiction to inquire into or alter a decision of the High Court or a decision of the Court of Appeal made under Article 83 or a decision of the Court of Appeal made under Article 117 of this Constitution. (3) Every conciliatory decision given by the Special Constitutional Court under this Article shall be final and there shall be no right of appeal to any forum.
